brief: Nasdaq 100 futures are up about 1.7% this morning after CoreWeave beat estimates and raised its outlook, lifting AI names after Tuesday's hot-CPI selloff. The US Treasury cash market is closed for Veterans Day, so the yield factor is scored 0; the 10-year closed Tuesday near 4.99% after an 11 bp jump. The dollar is firmer (EURUSD -0.28%, USDJPY +0.30%) and VIX is down about 5%. The level score is estimated from Tuesday's Nasdaq range because exact NQ high/low figures were not available. The key risk is renewed rate-hike pressure: markets fully price a December hike, and October PPI is due Friday.

sources.title: Investing.com: Nasdaq futures jump on CoreWeave
